statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); -(n:ℝ)/64 ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ)))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0105 · 反射块内差分的逐尺度单侧下界（开放）
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0105 · One-sided cancellation of reflected within-cell differences (open)

brief.zh: 按位移 t−s 重排，比较两侧素数权增量同号与异号的贡献。保留总和的符号和分母 2H；需要对每个充分大的 k 成立。
brief.en: Group by the lag t−s and compare aligned and opposed prime-weight increments. Keep the signed sum and denominator 2H. The bound must hold at every sufficiently large k.
